newsitem.title: RWANDA: Rwandans evacuate town because of Zaire fighting.
newsitem.headline: Rwandans evacuate town because of Zaire fighting.

text.p: Thousands of Rwandans fled from the Rwandan town of Gisenyi on Friday because of fighting just across the border in Zaire, a Reuters eyewitness said.
Reuters correspondent Christian Jennings said the town was emptying after three mortar bombs fired from Zaire hit Gisenyi. There was no immediate word of casualties.
The evacuation of Gisenyi was the worst reported instance of the fighting in Zaire affecting life on the Rwandan side of the border.
Jennings, in Gisenyi, said: "I just spent three hours pinned down under fire."
He said the town was emptying of people. Zairean and Rwandan troops were firing back and forth across the border, he said, adding that it seemed to be targeted and not just stray fire.
"Heavy firing is continuing across the border. Now the Zairean fire is coming into Gisenyi, into hills near Gisenyi and west of Goma," he said.
